Free math practice pack with answer keys

Three original arithmetic worksheets, 20 questions each, with a separate answer page after every activity. Print a ready-made A4 pack or make a fresh version in Worksheet Studio.

Download the 6-page practice pack ↓ Create a custom worksheet ↗

Published 5 November 2026 by Nepocore. Designed for home and classroom practice; no curriculum alignment, assessment result or learning guarantee is claimed.

A simple way to use the pack

  1. Choose one activity that matches a skill the learner has already met.
  2. Print only pages 1, 3 and 5 for question sheets. Keep pages 2, 4 and 6 for checking.
  3. Allow working time and ask the learner to explain a method for a few answers.
  4. Review errors together, then generate another short practice sheet if useful.

The PDF uses A4 pages, 210 × 297 mm. Match the printer paper setting and inspect a single-page preview before printing a batch. If using US Letter, check the printer’s fit setting and margins. See the A4 and Letter printing guide.

Make it fit the next lesson

The sample pack is a fixed set of examples. Worksheet Studio can generate new math questions, change difficulty and question count, choose A4 or US Letter, and include separate answer keys. For a different activity, make a spelling worksheet from your own words or a custom word-search puzzle.

For planning help, read how to build a manageable week of practice. For understanding calculations, try the scientific calculator and its worked degree-mode examples.

Share a useful resource

You may print and share these original sample sheets for home or classroom practice without an account or payment. A source mention is welcome but optional. Link to this resource page when you want readers to find the current pack, text version and custom generator together.

Suggested reference: Nepocore math practice pack — three printable worksheets with separate answer keys.
